title: An incentive changes a choice — template demo
narration_script: A reward changes the choice. The result is different.

shots.visual: One token moves between two labeled choices.
shots.first_frame: A token sits beside option A.
shots.change: The reward appears beside option B; the token moves toward it.
shots.last_frame: The token sits beside option B.

shots.visual: The consequence panel fills as tokens arrive.
shots.change: The chosen token enters the panel.
